segments.zh: 这部分基本上要讨论危险度等级，

segments.text: the classification of the biological agents
segments.zh: 即把生物因子划分为

segments.text: into the four risk groups,
segments.zh: 四个危险度等级，

segments.text: the containment levels at your laboratory
segments.zh: 以及你们实验室或设施的

segments.text: or your facility.
segments.zh: 防护等级。

segments.text: So if you are working with risk group three and above,
segments.zh: 如果你处理的是危险度3级及以上的因子，

segments.text: you need to have the appropriate BSL facility.
segments.zh: 就需要有相应的生物安全等级设施。

segments.text: And I will discuss this when we focus
segments.zh: 我会在讲工程控制措施

segments.text: on engineering controls
segments.zh: 和整体风险缓解方法时

segments.text: and the overall risk mitigation approach.
segments.zh: 讨论这一点。

segments.text: Protective clothing, PPEs are very important
segments.zh: 防护服、个人防护装备非常重要，

segments.text: and other protection.
segments.zh: 还有其他防护措施。

segments.text: I've included this basic hierarchy over here
segments.zh: 我在这里放了这个基本的层级图，

segments.text: to indicate the mitigation strategy
segments.zh: 用来说明缓解策略，

segments.text: which we will discuss in the lecture series
segments.zh: 我们会在风险缓解

segments.text: on risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 系列讲座中讨论。

segments.text: Section eight focuses on handling and storage.
segments.zh: 第八部分着重讲操作处理和储存。

segments.text: So how do we handle spills?
segments.zh: 我们如何处理溢洒？

segments.text: What is the spill cleanup, SOP?
segments.zh: 溢洒清理的标准操作规程是什么？

segments.text: Or if there's a very large spill
segments.zh: 或者如果发生非常大量的溢洒，

segments.text: which is highly unlikely as you are working
segments.zh: 这种情况极不可能，因为你操作的

segments.text: only in test tube levels or 50 ml or 100 ml of media.
segments.zh: 只是试管规模，或者50 ml、100 ml的培养基。

segments.text: But if you have very large spills
segments.zh: 但如果发生非常大量的溢洒，

segments.text: such as in environments which use a bioreactor
segments.zh: 比如在使用500升生物反应器

segments.text: or fermenter of 500 liters,
segments.zh: 或发酵罐的环境中，

segments.text: is there a SOP for handling this contingency
segments.zh: 是否有应对这种溢洒

segments.text: in case of a spill?
segments.zh: 突发情况的标准操作规程？

segments.text: Okay, that's what we look at.
segments.zh: 这就是我们要考察的。

segments.text: Disposal, what is the SOP for the disposal
segments.zh: 处置，该生物因子的处置

segments.text: of that particular biological agent?
segments.zh: 标准操作规程是什么？

segments.text: Again, you have to look at the susceptibility
segments.zh: 同样，你必须考察该生物因子

segments.text: of the biological agent to heat and chemical treatment.
segments.zh: 对热处理和化学处理的敏感性。

segments.text: The general route is via the usage of incinerator
segments.zh: 一般途径是使用焚烧炉

segments.text: or autoclaving system and effluent disposal and storage.
segments.zh: 或高压灭菌系统，还有污水处置和储存。

segments.text: Is the biological agent viable in storage?
segments.zh: 该生物因子在储存状态下是否存活？

segments.text: Or do you want to keep it viable in storage
segments.zh: 还是说你希望它在储存中保持存活，

segments.text: and maintain its viability
segments.zh: 维持其活性，

segments.text: for future downstream applications
segments.zh: 以便用于后续应用，

segments.text: such as a vaccine development?
segments.zh: 比如疫苗研发？

segments.text: Or do you want to destroy it
segments.zh: 或者你希望把它灭活，

segments.text: and maintain it in the storage as a DNA or RNA,
segments.zh: 以适合分析的DNA或RNA形式

segments.text: which is suitable for analysis?
segments.zh: 保存起来？

segments.text: Section nine focuses on regulatory and other information.
segments.zh: 第九部分着重讲法规和其他信息。

segments.text: This information must be included in your PhDs.
segments.zh: 这些信息必须写进你们的PSDS中。

segments.text: Now, every PhDs is a controlled document
segments.zh: 每一份PSDS都是受控文件，

segments.text: which is developed by the virus manager
segments.zh: 由该设施的生物风险管理者

segments.text: for that respective facility.
segments.zh: 编制。

segments.text: For instance, if a biological agent
segments.zh: 例如，某种生物因子

segments.text: has certain characteristics in a tropical country,
segments.zh: 在热带国家具有某些特性，

segments.text: the characteristics may be different in a temperate country
segments.zh: 而在温带国家特性可能不同，

segments.text: and this must be taken into consideration.
segments.zh: 这一点必须加以考虑。

segments.text: So the regulatory information must be included
segments.zh: 因此，法规信息必须写入

segments.text: in the Ethrogen Safety Data Sheet,
segments.zh: 病原体安全数据表，

segments.text: the date on which the information has been updated,
segments.zh: 还要写明信息更新的日期、

segments.text: the person who updated the information,
segments.zh: 更新信息的人员

segments.text: and the current references.
segments.zh: 以及最新的参考资料。

segments.text: And this completes the PhDs template.
segments.zh: 这样就完成了PSDS模板。

segments.text: Now, in order to identify or determine
segments.zh: 要查明或确定

segments.text: if your biological agent belongs to a specific risk group
segments.zh: 你的生物因子是否属于某个特定危险度等级，

segments.text: or has been categorized into a specific risk group,
segments.zh: 或者是否已被划入某个特定危险度等级，

segments.text: all you need to do is visit the PhDs,
segments.zh: 你只需访问PSDS，

segments.text: key in the correct name of your biological agent,
segments.zh: 输入你的生物因子的正确名称，

segments.text: for example, Bacillus anthracis,
segments.zh: 例如炭疽芽孢杆菌，

segments.text: and then you search for all of these information
segments.zh: 然后在PSDS中

segments.text: in the PhDs itself.
segments.zh: 检索所有这些信息。

segments.text: This brings us to the end of this particular lecture.
segments.zh: 本讲到此结束。

segments.zh: 我们重点讲了以世卫组织《实验室生物安全手册》为参考的

segments.text: using the WHO-LBM as a reference.
segments.zh: 微生物风险评估。

segments.zh: 我们理解了风险评估的范围，

segments.text: as I indicated in the iceberg example.
segments.zh: 就像我在冰山例子中说明的那样。

segments.zh: 有些风险是可见的，

segments.zh: 有些风险是不可见的。

segments.text: And no matter how exhaustive the virus management strategy
segments.zh: 无论生物风险管理策略多么详尽，

segments.text: may be, there'll be always be certain risks
segments.zh: 总会有一些你无法预测的

segments.text: which you cannot predict.
segments.zh: 风险。

segments.zh: 不过，你作为生物风险管理者的职责

segments.text: is to ensure that the risk assessment is thorough
segments.zh: 是确保风险评估做到全面

segments.text: and comprehensive.

segments.zh: 我们还了解了病原体安全数据表。

segments.zh: 甚至数十万的生物风险管理者。

segments.zh: 到这个阶段，

segments.zh: 基本问题，
